steps.label: ATOMICITY
steps.sub: a commit completes entirely, or leaves no trace

steps.label: CONSISTENCY
steps.sub: every reader sees a valid, complete state

steps.label: ISOLATION
steps.sub: writers don't see each other's uncommitted changes

steps.label: DURABILITY
steps.sub: once committed, permanent -- same as the cloud storage underneath

code:
Writer A reads v5, starts writing v6
Writer B reads v5, starts writing v6 (same time)

A commits v6 first -- succeeds.
B tries v6 -- CONFLICT. Delta re-checks:
  no real conflict?  -> B becomes v7, automatically
  real conflict?      -> B's write fails, retry
caption: No locking -- both proceed, and only conflicts get checked at commit time.
